source: Blind per-bin reading of Heister, arXiv:1610.06536 v9, HTML Figure 24, caption beginning 'The opposite sign di-muon mass spectrum for events where the b-tag was inverted, i.e. P_H,mass,max < 2'. 'Events / 1 GeV', LOGARITHMIC y axis (about 0.29 to 530, decade ticks 1, 10, 10^2), x 0-50 GeV, 1 GeV bins. ALEPH archived data (black dots with error bars) against ALEPH simulation drawn as a stacked filled histogram (green b events, red c events, blue uds events; green top = total simulation). Read by an AI reading agent with no access to MV2's repositories, from exact SVG vector coordinates; report completed 2026-11-21T06:21Z. Values copied exactly as read, no edits. A null value is NM (no data marker drawn in that bin) or OFF (the simulation lies below the bottom of the log axis); see 'marks'. Reader's uncertainty: data exact whole numbers (+-0.003), simulation +-0.01 plus one-decimal rounding (+-0.05); bin 24 simulation 13.65 and bin 39 1.050 were rounded up. Reader's sums: 15-25 data 331 / simulation 317.2; 25-50 data 90 / simulation 76.9 (excluding 7 OFF bins, each < 0.3); NM 10 (data 36, 37, 39, 43-49), OFF 7 (simulation 43-49).
